description: Open-source CRM platform designed for technical teams with extensible building blocks, REST/GraphQL APIs, and AI agent integration.
auth_notes: Supports API keys, bearer tokens, and OAuth2 for authenticating requests and public apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a cloud trial/account or self-host the open-source version for free to generate credentials.
api_notes: Covers core CRM objects, data models, workflows, custom apps, and webhooks via REST and GraphQL.
mcp_notes: Twenty provides a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server built into its cloud workspaces and packaged apps.
rationale: Twenty features comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs, native MCP support, and self-serve free developer access.
